            args.no_tree = True
        elif arg.startswith('--max-depth='):
            args.max_depth = int(arg[12:])
        elif arg == '--max-depth':
            args.max_depth = int(get_val(arg))
        elif arg.startswith('--outcmd='):
            args.outcmd = arg[9:]
        elif arg == '--outcmd':
            args.outcmd = get_val(arg)
        elif arg.startswith('--conf='):
            args.conf = arg[7:]
        elif arg == '--conf':
            args.conf = get_val(arg)
        elif arg == '--install':
            args.install = True
        elif arg.startswith('--set-install-state='):
            args.set_install_state = arg[20:]
        elif arg == '--set-install-state':
            args.set_install_state = get_val(arg)
        elif arg.startswith('--print-shell-function='):
            args.print_shell_function = arg[23:]
        elif arg == '--print-shell-function':
            args.print_shell_function = get_val(arg)
        elif arg.startswith('--listen='):
            args.listen = arg[9:]
        elif arg == '--listen':
            args.listen = get_val(arg)
        elif arg == '--listen-auto':
            args.listen_auto = True
        elif arg == '--get-root':
            args.get_root = True
        elif arg.startswith('--write-default-conf='):
            args.write_default_conf = arg[21:]
        elif arg == '--write-default-conf':
            args.write_default_conf = get_val(arg)
        elif arg.startswith('--send='):
            args.send = arg[7:]
        elif arg == '--send':
            args.send = get_val(arg)
        elif arg.startswith('--verb-output='):
            args.verb_output = arg[14:]
        elif arg == '--verb-output':
            args.verb_output = get_val(arg)
        elif arg == '--':
            i += 1
            if i < len(argv):
                args.root = argv[i]
            break
        elif arg.startswith('-') and len(arg) > 1:
            # Possibly combined short flags like -sdp
            # Try to parse each char
            j = 1
            while j < len(arg):
                c = arg[j]
                if c == 's': args.sizes = True
                elif c == 'S': args.no_sizes = True
                elif c == 'd': args.dates = True
                elif c == 'D': args.no_dates = True
                elif c == 'p': args.permissions = True
                elif c == 'P': args.no_permissions = True
                elif c == 'h': args.hidden = True
                elif c == 'H': args.no_hidden = True
                elif c == 'i': args.git_ignored = True
                elif c == 'I': args.no_git_ignored = True
                elif c == 'g': args.show_git_info = True
                elif c == 'G': args.no_show_git_info = True
                elif c == 'f': args.only_folders = True
                elif c == 'F': args.no_only_folders = True
                elif c == 'w': args.whale_spotting = True
                elif c == 't': args.trim_root = True
                elif c == 'T': args.no_trim_root = True
                elif c == 'V': args.version = True
                elif c == 'c':
                    # -c needs value
                    if j + 1 < len(arg):
                        args.cmd = arg[j+1:]
                    else:
                        i += 1
                        args.cmd = argv[i] if i < len(argv) else ""
                    break
                j += 1
        else:
            # Positional argument = root path
            args.root = arg
        
        i += 1
    
    # whale-spotting implies hidden and git-ignored
    if args.whale_spotting:
        args.hidden = True
        args.git_ignored = True
        if not args.sort_by_size:
            args.sort_by_size = True
    
    return args

# ── Terminal utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_terminal_size():
    try:
        size = os.get_terminal_size()
        return size.lines, size.columns
    except OSError:
        return 24, 80

def get_tty_fd():
    """Get file descriptor for the terminal"""
    try:
        return os.open('/dev/tty', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY)
    except OSError:
        return None

# ── TUI Implementation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class BrootTUI:
    def __init__(self, root_path, args, tty_fd=None):
        self.root_path = Path(root_path).resolve()
        self.args = args
        self.tty_fd = tty_fd
        
        # Display state
        self.height, self.width = get_terminal_size()
        if args.height:
            self.virtual_height = args.height
        else:
            self.virtual_height = self.height
        
        # Input state
        self.input_text = ""
        self.selected_idx = 0
        self.scroll_offset = 0
        
        # Flag state
        self.show_hidden = args.hidden or args.whale_spotting
        self.show_git_ignored = args.git_ignored  # True = show git-ignored (gitignore off)
        self.only_folders = args.only_folders
        
        # Navigation history
        self.history = []
        
        # Tree content
        self.flat_nodes = []  # Flat list of visible nodes
        self.needs_rebuild = True
        
        # Verb input mode
        self.verb_mode = False
        
        # Color enabled
        self.colors = (args.color != "no")
        
    def get_opts(self):
        return {
            'hidden': self.show_hidden,
            'git_ignored': self.show_git_ignored,
            'only_folders': self.only_folders,
            'max_depth': self.args.max_depth,
        }
    
    def get_tree_height(self):
        """Number of rows available for tree display (including root)"""
        return self.virtual_height - 2  # Subtract status bar and input line
    
    def rebuild_tree(self):
        """Rebuild the flat node list"""
        available = self.get_tree_height()
        if available < 1:
            available = 1
        
        tree = Tree(self.root_path, self.get_opts())
        
        if self.input_text:
            # Search mode
            self._build_search_tree(tree, available)
        else:
            tree.build(available)
        
        self.flat_nodes = self._flatten_tree(tree.nodes)
        self.needs_rebuild = False
        
        # Adjust selection
        if self.selected_idx >= len(self.flat_nodes):
            self.selected_idx = max(0, len(self.flat_nodes) - 1)
    
    def _build_search_tree(self, tree, available):
        """Build tree with search filtering"""
        pattern = self.input_text
        root_node = FileNode(self.root_path)
        root_node.depth = 0
        
        # Find all matching files
        matches = self._find_matches(self.root_path, pattern)
        
        if not matches:
            tree.nodes = [root_node]
            return
        
        # Build a tree showing only matching paths
        tree.nodes = [root_node] + self._build_match_nodes(matches, available - 1)
    
    def _find_matches(self, dirpath, pattern, depth=0, max_results=1000):
        """Find files matching pattern, returning list of (rel_path, abs_path, is_dir)"""
        results = []
        
        try:
            entries = list(os.scandir(dirpath))
        except (PermissionError, OSError):
            return results
        
        entries.sort(key=lambda e: e.name.lower())
        
        for entry in entries:
            name = entry.name
            if not self.show_hidden and name.startswith('.'):
                continue
            
            try:
                is_dir = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=True)
            except OSError:
                is_dir = False
            
            # Build relative path from root
            rel_path = str(Path(entry.path).relative_to(self.root_path))
            
            if self._matches_pattern(pattern, rel_path, name):
                results.append((rel_path, entry.path, is_dir))
            
            if is_dir and depth < 20 and len(results) < max_results:
                sub = self._find_matches(entry.path, pattern, depth+1, max_results - len(results))
                results.extend(sub)
        
        return results[:max_results]
    
    def _matches_pattern(self, pattern, path, name):
        """Check if pattern matches path or name"""
        pattern_lower = pattern.lower()
        path_lower = path.lower()
        
        # Fuzzy path match (default)
        return self._fuzzy_match(pattern_lower, path_lower)
    
    def _fuzzy_match(self, pattern, text):
        """Check if pattern matches text with fuzzy algorithm"""
        if not pattern:
            return True
        pi = 0
        for ch in text:
            if ch == pattern[pi]:
                pi += 1
                if pi == len(pattern):
                    return True
        return False
    
    def _build_match_nodes(self, matches, budget):
        """Build display nodes for search results"""
        if not matches or budget <= 0:
            return []
        
        nodes = []
        for rel_path, abs_path, is_dir in matches[:budget]:
            node = FileNode(abs_path, depth=1)
            # Override name to show relative path
            node.name = str(self.root_path / rel_path)
            nodes.append(node)
        
        return nodes
    
    def _flatten_tree(self, nodes, prefix_stack=None):
        """Flatten tree to list of (node, prefix, is_last) tuples"""
        if prefix_stack is None:
            prefix_stack = []
        
        result = []
        for i, node in enumerate(nodes):
            is_last = (i == len(nodes) - 1)
            result.append((node, list(prefix_stack), is_last))
            
            if node.children:
                new_stack = prefix_stack + [not is_last]
                result.extend(self._flatten_tree(node.children, new_stack))
        
        return result
    
    def run(self):
        """Main TUI loop"""
        # Set up terminal
        tty_fd = self.tty_fd
        if tty_fd is None:
            try:
                tty_fd = os.open('/dev/tty', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY)
            except OSError:
                return self._run_non_tty()
        
        # Save terminal state
        old_settings = termios.tcgetattr(tty_fd)
        
        # Write to stderr (the TUI goes to stderr)
        tty_file = os.fdopen(tty_fd, 'r+b', buffering=0)
        
        try:
            # Enter raw mode
            tty.setraw(tty_fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH)
            
            # Enter alternate screen
            tty_file.write(ALT_SCREEN_ON.encode())
            tty_file.write(HIDE_CURSOR.encode())
            tty_file.write(MOUSE_ON.encode())
            tty_file.flush()
            
            result = self._tui_loop(tty_file)
            
        finally:
            # Restore terminal
            tty_file.write(MOUSE_OFF.encode())
            tty_file.write(SHOW_CURSOR.encode())
            tty_file.write(ALT_SCREEN_OFF.encode())
            tty_file.flush()
            termios.tcsetattr(tty_fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH, old_settings)
        
        return result
    
    def _run_non_tty(self):
        """Run when no TTY available"""
        return None
    
    def _tui_loop(self, tty_file):
        """Main event loop for TUI"""
        self.tty_file = tty_file
        self.rebuild_tree()
        self._redraw()
        
        result = None
        
        while True:
            # Read input
            ch = self._read_key(tty_file)
            
            if ch is None:
                continue
            
            action = self._handle_key(ch)
            
            if action == 'quit':
                result = None
                break
            elif action == 'print_tree':
                result = ('print_tree', self.root_path)
                break
            elif action == 'cd':
                selected = self._get_selected_node()
                if selected and selected.is_dir:
                    result = ('cd', selected.path)
                break
            elif action == 'open':
                selected = self._get_selected_node()
                if selected:
                    result = ('open', selected.path)
                break
            
            if self.needs_rebuild:
                self.rebuild_tree()
            self._redraw()
        
        return result
    
    def _read_key(self, tty_file):
        """Read a key from tty"""
        try:
            ch = tty_file.read(1)
            if not ch:
                return None
            
            b = ord(ch)
            
            # Escape sequences
            if b == 27:
                try:
                    fcntl.fcntl(tty_file.fileno(), fcntl.F_SETFL, os.O_NONBLOCK)
                    next_bytes = tty_file.read(10)
                    fcntl.fcntl(tty_file.fileno(), fcntl.F_SETFL, 0)
                    if next_bytes:
                        return b'\x1b' + next_bytes
                    return b'\x1b'
                except:
                    return b'\x1b'
            
            return ch
        except (IOError, OSError):
            return None
    
    def _handle_key(self, ch):
        """Handle a key press, return action or None"""
        if isinstance(ch, bytes):
            b = ch
        else:
            b = ch.encode() if isinstance(ch, str) else ch
        
        # Escape sequences
        if b == b'\x1b':
            # Pure escape
            if self.input_text:
                self.input_text = ""
                self.verb_mode = False
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            elif self.history:
                # Go back
                self.root_path, self.selected_idx = self.history.pop()
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        if b == b'\x1b[A' or b == b'\x1b[OA':  # Up arrow
            self._move_selection(-1)
            return None
        
        if b == b'\x1b[B' or b == b'\x1b[OB':  # Down arrow
            self._move_selection(1)
            return None
        
        if b == b'\x1b[5~':  # Page up
            self._move_selection(-10)
            return None
        
        if b == b'\x1b[6~':  # Page down
            self._move_selection(10)
            return None
        
        if b == b'\r' or b == b'\n':  # Enter
            return self._handle_enter()
        
        if b == b'\x7f' or b == b'\x08':  # Backspace
            if self.input_text:
                self.input_text = self.input_text[:-1]
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        if b == b'\x03':  # Ctrl-C
            return 'quit'
        
        if b == b'\x04':  # Ctrl-D
            return 'quit'
        
        if b == b'?':
            if not self.input_text and not self.verb_mode:
                self._show_help()
                return None
        
        # Regular characters
        if len(b) == 1:
            c = chr(b[0])
            if c == ' ':
                self.verb_mode = True
                self.input_text = ""
                self.needs_rebuild = False  # Just redraw
                self._redraw()
                return None
            elif c == ':':
                self.verb_mode = True
                self.input_text = ":"
                self.needs_rebuild = False
                self._redraw()
                return None
            elif c.isprintable() or ord(c) > 127:
                if self.verb_mode:
                    self.input_text += c
                    # Check for verb completion
                    verb = self.input_text.lstrip(': ')
                    if verb in ('q', 'quit'):
                        pass  # Will be handled on Enter
                    elif verb in ('pt', 'print_tree'):
                        pass
                else:
                    self.input_text += c
                    self.needs_rebuild = True
                return None
        
        # Multi-byte (UTF-8)
        if len(b) > 1 and b[0] == 0x1b:
            seq = b
            # Alt-Enter
            if seq == b'\x1b\r' or seq == b'\x1b\n':
                selected = self._get_selected_node()
                if selected:
                    return 'open'
            # Alt-h: toggle hidden
            elif seq == b'\x1bh':
                self.show_hidden = not self.show_hidden
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            # Alt-i: toggle git-ignored
            elif seq == b'\x1bi':
                self.show_git_ignored = not self.show_git_ignored
                self.needs_rebuild = True
        
        return None
    
    def _handle_enter(self):
        """Handle Enter key"""
        if self.verb_mode:
            verb = self.input_text.strip().lstrip(': ')
            self.input_text = ""
            self.verb_mode = False
            
            if verb in ('q', 'quit'):
                return 'quit'
            elif verb in ('pt', 'print_tree'):
                return 'print_tree'
            elif verb.startswith('focus '):
                path = verb[6:].strip()
                if path.startswith('~'):
                    path = str(Path.home()) + path[1:]
                new_path = Path(path)
                if new_path.is_dir():
                    self.history.append((self.root_path, self.selected_idx))
                    self.root_path = new_path
                    self.selected_idx = 0
                    self.needs_rebuild = True
            self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        # Navigate into directory
        selected = self._get_selected_node()
        if selected:
            if selected.is_dir:
                # Go into directory
                self.history.append((self.root_path, self.selected_idx))
                self.root_path = selected.path
                self.selected_idx = 0
                self.input_text = ""
                self.needs_rebuild = True
                return None
            else:
                # Open file or navigate up
                pass
        else:
            # No selection, go up
            parent = self.root_path.parent
            if parent != self.root_path:
                self.history.append((self.root_path, self.selected_idx))
                self.root_path = parent
                self.selected_idx = 0
                self.needs_rebuild = True
        
        return None
    
    def _move_selection(self, delta):
        """Move selection by delta"""
        # Skip root node (index 0)
        selectable = [i for i, (node, _, _) in enumerate(self.flat_nodes) 
                      if i > 0 and node.path is not None]
        
        if not selectable:
            return
        
        if self.selected_idx == 0 and delta > 0:
            self.selected_idx = selectable[0]
            return
        
        try:
            cur_pos = selectable.index(self.selected_idx)
        except ValueError:
            self.selected_idx = selectable[0]
            return
        
        new_pos = max(0, min(len(selectable)-1, cur_pos + delta))
        self.selected_idx = selectable[new_pos]
    
    def _get_selected_node(self):
        """Get the currently selected node"""
        if 0 <= self.selected_idx < len(self.flat_nodes):
            node, _, _ = self.flat_nodes[self.selected_idx]
            return node
        return None
    
    def _show_help(self):
        """Show help screen briefly"""
        pass  # TODO: implement help screen
    
    def _redraw(self):
        """Redraw the entire TUI"""
        h = self.virtual_height
        w = self.width
        
        output = []
        
        # Move to top-left
        output.append(GOTO(1, 1).encode())
        
        tree_height = h - 2
        
        # Draw tree lines
        for row in range(1, tree_height + 1):
            output.append(GOTO(row, 1).encode())
            
            if row == 1:
                # Root line
                if self.colors:
                    output.append((COLOR_ROOT + str(self.root_path) + RESET + 
                                  fg256(254) + bg256(238)).encode())
                else:
                    output.append(str(self.root_path).encode())
                output.append((' ' * max(0, w - len(str(self.root_path)))).encode())
                if self.colors:
                    output.append(RESET.encode())
            else:
                idx = row - 2 + self.scroll_offset  # Index into flat_nodes (skip root)
                if idx < len(self.flat_nodes) - 1:  # -1 because flat_nodes[0] is root
                    node, prefix_stack, is_last = self.flat_nodes[idx + 1]
                    line = self._render_node_line(node, prefix_stack, is_last, 
                                                   idx + 1 == self.selected_idx, w)
                    output.append(line.encode())
                else:
                    # Empty line
                    output.append((' ' * w).encode())
                    if self.colors:
                        output.append(RESET.encode())
        
        # Status bar
        output.append(GOTO(h - 1, 1).encode())
        status = self._get_status_text()
        if self.colors:
            output.append((COLOR_STATUS_BG + COLOR_STATUS_FG + ' ' + status + 
                          ' ' * max(0, w - len(status) - 1) + RESET).encode())
        else:
            output.append((' ' + status + ' ' * max(0, w - len(status) - 1)).encode())
        
        # Input/flags line
        output.append(GOTO(h, 1).encode())
        
        input_display = self.input_text if self.input_text else ""
        flags = self._get_flags_display()
        
        if self.colors:
            cursor = " " if not self.input_text else ""
            input_part = (COLOR_INPUT_BG + COLOR_INPUT_FG + 
                         "\x1b[7m \x1b[0m" +
                         COLOR_INPUT_FG + COLOR_INPUT_BG + 
                         input_display + ' ' * max(0, w - len(flags) - len(input_display) - 1) +
                         RESET)
            flags_part = (COLOR_FLAG_KEY + " h:" + COLOR_FLAG_VAL + 
                         ("y" if self.show_hidden else "n") + RESET +
                         COLOR_FLAG_KEY + "  gi:" + COLOR_FLAG_VAL +
                         ("n" if self.show_git_ignored else "y") + RESET +
                         COLOR_INPUT_BG + " " + RESET)
        else:
            input_part = input_display
            flags_part = f" h:{'y' if self.show_hidden else 'n'}  gi:{'n' if self.show_git_ignored else 'y'}"
        
        output.append((COLOR_INPUT_BG if self.colors else b'').encode() if isinstance(input_part, str) else b'')
        
        # Simpler approach for input line
        if self.colors:
            sel_mark = "\x1b[7m\x1b[38;5;231m\x1b[48;5;234m \x1b[0m"
            h_val = "y" if self.show_hidden else "n"
            gi_val = "n" if self.show_git_ignored else "y"
            flags_str = (f"\x1b[38;5;247m\x1b[48;5;234m h:\x1b[1m\x1b[38;5;178mn\x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;247m\x1b[48;5;234m  gi:\x1b[1m\x1b[38;5;178my\x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;247m\x1b[48;5;234m \x1b[38;5;254m\x1b[49m")
            flags_str = flags_str.replace("n\x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;247m\x1b[48;5;234m  gi:\x1b[1m\x1b[38;5;178my", 
                                          f"{h_val}\x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;247m\x1b[48;5;234m  gi:\x1b[1m\x1b[38;5;178m{gi_val}")
            input_line = (f"\x1b[38;5;231m\x1b[48;5;234m{sel_mark}"
                         f"\x1b[38;5;231m\x1b[48;5;234m{input_display}"
                         f"\x1b[38;5;254m\x1b[49m")
            # Pad and add flags
            visible_len = 1 + len(input_display)  # sel_mark(1) + text
            flags_visible = f" h:{'y' if self.show_hidden else 'n'}  gi:{'n' if self.show_git_ignored else 'y'} "
            pad = max(0, w - visible_len - len(flags_visible))
            full_line = input_line + " " * pad + flags_str
            output.append(full_line.encode())
        else:
            flags_str = f" h:{'y' if self.show_hidden else 'n'}  gi:{'n' if self.show_git_ignored else 'y'}"
            pad = max(0, w - len(input_display) - len(flags_str))
            output.append((input_display + " " * pad + flags_str).encode())
        
        self.tty_file.write(b''.join(output))
        self.tty_file.flush()
    
    def _render_node_line(self, node, prefix_stack, is_last, selected, width):
        """Render a single tree node line"""
        prefix = ""
        for has_more in prefix_stack:
            prefix += VERT_CONT if has_more else INDENT
        
        branch = BRANCH_LAST if is_last else BRANCH_MID
        
        if node.path is None:
            name = node.name + " "
        elif node.is_dir and node.collapsed and not node.children:
            name = node.name + f" {ELLIPSIS} "
        else:
            name = node.name + " "
        
        # Selection marker
        sel_mark = "\u25b6" if selected else " "
        
        full = f"{sel_mark}{prefix}{branch}{name}"
        
        # Pad to width
        # Calculate visible length (approximate, ignoring color codes)
        visible_len = len(full)
        pad = max(0, width - visible_len)
        
        if self.colors:
            if selected:
                return (COLOR_SELECT_MARK + sel_mark + RESET +
                        COLOR_TREE_CHARS + prefix + branch + RESET +
                        (COLOR_DIR if (node.is_dir and node.path) else COLOR_FILE) +
                        name + RESET +
                        " " * pad)
            else:
                if node.path is None:
                    return (" " + COLOR_TREE_CHARS + prefix + branch + RESET +
                            COLOR_UNLISTED + name + RESET + " " * pad)
                return (" " + COLOR_TREE_CHARS + prefix + branch + RESET +
                        (COLOR_DIR if node.is_dir else COLOR_FILE) +
                        name + RESET + " " * pad)
        else:
            return full + " " * pad
    
    def _get_status_text(self):
        """Get the status bar text"""
        if self.verb_mode:
            return "Type a verb then enter to execute it (? for the list of verbs)"
        
        if self.input_text:
            selected = self._get_selected_node()
            if selected and selected.is_dir:
                return "Hit enter to focus, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
            return "Hit alt-Enter to open and quit, esc to clear the filter, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
        
        selected = self._get_selected_node()
        if selected:
            if selected.is_dir:
                return "Hit enter to focus, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
            return "Hit enter to open, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
        
        if self.history:
            return "Hit esc to go back, enter to go up, ? for help, or a few letters to search"
        
        return "Hit enter to go up, ? for help, or a few letters to search"
    
    def _get_flags_display(self):
        """Get the flags display string"""
        h_val = "y" if self.show_hidden else "n"
        gi_val = "n" if self.show_git_ignored else "y"
        return f"h:{h_val}  gi:{gi_val}"

# ── Main execution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def print_tree_output(root_path, args):
    """Print tree to stdout (for :pt / print_tree command)"""
    h = args.height or 30
    
    # Calculate available lines: h - 2 (status bar + input line)
    # But use at least 1 for root
    available = max(1, h - 2)
    
    opts = {
        'hidden': args.hidden or args.whale_spotting,
        'git_ignored': args.git_ignored,
        'only_folders': args.only_folders,
        'max_depth': args.max_depth,
    }
    
    lines = render_tree_to_lines(root_path, available, opts)
    
    # Write to stdout as bytes
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(l.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(l, str) else l 
                                      for l in lines))
    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()

def main():
    args = parse_args(sys.argv)
    
    # Handle --version
    if args.version:
        print(VERSION)
        return 0
    
    # Handle --help
    if args.help:
        help_bytes = get_help_text()
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(help_bytes)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return 0
    
    # Handle --print-shell-function
    if args.print_shell_function is not None:
        func_bytes = get_shell_function(args.print_shell_function)
        if func_bytes is None:
            print(f"Unknown shell: {args.print_shell_function}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(func_bytes)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return 0
    
    # Handle --write-default-conf
    if args.write_default_conf:
        write_default_conf(args.write_default_conf)
        return 0
    
    # Handle --set-install-state
    if args.set_install_state:
        set_install_state(args.set_install_state)
        return 0
    
    # Handle --install
    if args.install:
        do_install()
        return 0
    
    # Ensure config exists
    ensure_config_exists()
    
    # Determine root path
    root_path = args.root or os.getcwd()
    root_path = Path(root_path).resolve()
    
    if not root_path.exists():
        print(f"broot: {root_path}: No such file or directory", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    
    if not root_path.is_dir():
        root_path = root_path.parent
    
    # Check install state
    state = get_install_state()
    if state == "undefined":
        do_install()
        state = get_install_state()
    
    # Handle --cmd (command to execute)
    if args.cmd:
        commands = args.cmd.split(';')
        for cmd in commands:
            cmd = cmd.strip()
            if cmd in (':pt', ':print_tree', 'pt', 'print_tree'):
                print_tree_output(root_path, args)
                return 0
            elif cmd == ':quit' or cmd == ':q':
                return 0
    
    # Enter TUI mode
    if not sys.stderr.isatty():
        # Can't do TUI without tty
        print_tree_output(root_path, args)
        return 0
    
    tui = BrootTUI(root_path, args)
    result = tui.run()
    
    if result:
        action, path = result
        if action == 'print_tree':
            # Create a fresh args for print with same options but specific height
            print_args = Args()
            print_args.height = args.height or get_terminal_size()[0]
            print_args.hidden = tui.show_hidden
            print_args.git_ignored = tui.show_git_ignored
            print_args.only_folders = tui.only_folders
            print_args.max_depth = args.max_depth
            print_tree_output(tui.root_path, print_args)
        elif action == 'cd':
            if args.outcmd:
                Path(args.outcmd).write_text(f"cd {path}\n")
    
    return 0

# "N unlisted" - directory IS expanded but all N children are listed as "N unlisted"

# 4. If a dir gets 1 extra slot: show with "N unlisted" line

def _build_subtree(children, depth, budget, prefix_stack, show_hidden, only_dirs):
    """
    Build tree lines for a list of children.
    budget: max lines to use
    Returns list of strings.
    """
    if not children or budget <= 0:
        return []
    
    n = len(children)
    
    if n <= budget:
        # All children fit. Distribute extra budget among dirs.
        result = []
        extra = budget - n  # Extra lines beyond one per child
        
        # Count dirs that can be expanded
        dirs = [(i, name, path, is_dir) for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children) if is_dir]
        
        # Distribute extra budget among dirs
        if extra > 0 and dirs:
            # Calculate allocation per dir
            # Broot seems to allocate greedily from the end
            # Let's try: process dirs from last to first
            # Each dir that can be expanded cheaply gets priority
            
            # Count children of each dir
            dir_info = []
            for i, name, path, is_dir in dirs:
                sub_children = get_sorted_children(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                dir_info.append((i, name, path, is_dir, sub_children))
            
            # Allocate budget to dirs
            dir_budgets = {}
            remaining_extra = extra
            
            # Process dirs - we need a budget for each
            # Simple approach: divide extra evenly, give remainder to last dirs
            if dir_info:
                per_dir = remaining_extra // len(dir_info)
                rem = remaining_extra % len(dir_info)
                for j, (i, name, path, is_dir, sub) in enumerate(dir_info):
                    b = per_dir
                    if j >= len(dir_info) - rem:
                        b += 1
                    dir_budgets[i] = b
        else:
            dir_budgets = {}
        
        # Build result
        for idx, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
            is_last = (idx == n - 1)
            branch = BRANCH_LAST if is_last else BRANCH_MID
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if x else INDENT for x in prefix_stack)
            
            child_budget = dir_budgets.get(idx, 0) if is_dir else 0
            
            sub_children = get_sorted_children(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            
            if is_dir and child_budget > 0 and sub_children:
                # Expand this dir
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} ")
                new_stack = prefix_stack + [not is_last]
                sub_lines = _build_subtree(sub_children, depth+1, child_budget, 
                                           new_stack, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                result.extend(sub_lines)
            elif is_dir and sub_children:
                # Collapsed with ellipsis
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} ")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} ")
        
        return result
    else:
        # More children than budget. Show first (budget-1) with ellipsis, then "N unlisted"
        result = []
        
        if budget == 0:
            return []
        
        show_count = budget - 1  # Last slot for "N unlisted"
        if show_count <= 0:
            # Only 1 slot: show "N unlisted"
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if x else INDENT for x in prefix_stack)
            count = n
            result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{count} unlisted ")
            return result
        
        for idx in range(show_count):
            name, path, is_dir = children[idx]
            is_last_shown = (idx == show_count - 1) and (n - show_count == 0)
            # Last item is always show_count-1 unless there are unlisted ones
            is_last = (idx == show_count - 1) and False  # Never truly last if there are unlisted
            branch = BRANCH_MID  # Always mid since there's unlisted after
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if x else INDENT for x in prefix_stack)
            
            sub_children = get_sorted_children(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            if is_dir and sub_children:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} ")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} ")
        
        # Add unlisted
        unlisted_count = n - show_count
        prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if x else INDENT for x in prefix_stack)
        result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{unlisted_count} unlisted ")
        
        return result

def test_tree(path, height, expected_lines=None):
    # Formula: effective = max(h-2, min(h-1, base_state))
    root_children = get_sorted_children(path)
    base_state = 1 + len(root_children)  # root + root items
    effective = max(height - 2, min(height - 1, base_state))
    
    lines = build_tree(path, effective)
    print(f"h={height}: {len(lines)} lines (effective={effective})")
    for l in lines:
        print(f"  {repr(l)}")
    if expected_lines:
        if len(lines) != expected_lines:
            print(f"  ERROR: expected {expected_lines} lines!")
    print()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""broot 1.54.0 - A way to navigate directory trees"""

import sys
import os
import re

import tty

# ── Box-drawing / tree characters ─────────────────────────────────────────────
BRANCH_MID  = "├──"   # U+251C U+2500 U+2500
BRANCH_LAST = "└──"   # U+2514 U+2500 U+2500
VERT_CONT   = "│  "   # U+2502 + 2 spaces
INDENT      = "   "   # 3 spaces
ELLIPSIS    = "…"     # U+2026
SEL_MARK    = "▶"     # U+25B6

# ── ANSI escape helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ESC = "\x1b"
def _csi(*args): return ESC + "[" + ";".join(str(a) for a in args) + "m"

BOLD      = _csi(1)
ITALIC    = _csi(3)
UNDERLINE = _csi(4)

def bg(n):  return _csi(48,5,n)
def fg_r(): return _csi(39)
def bg_r(): return _csi(49)
def goto(r, c): return ESC + f"[{r};{c}H"
HIDE_CURSOR  = ESC + "[?25l"
SHOW_CURSOR  = ESC + "[?25h"
ALT_ON       = ESC + "[?1049h"
ALT_OFF      = ESC + "[?1049l"
MOUSE_ON     = (ESC+"[?1000h"+ESC+"[?1002h"+ESC+"[?1003h"+ESC+"[?1015h"+ESC+"[?1006h")
MOUSE_OFF    = (ESC+"[?1006l"+ESC+"[?1015l"+ESC+"[?1003l"+ESC+"[?1002l"+ESC+"[?1000l")
CLEAR_SCR    = ESC + "[2J"

# ── File system helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def list_dir(path, show_hidden=False, only_dirs=False):
    """Return sorted list of (name, abs_path, is_dir) for path."""
    try:
        entries = list(os.scandir(path))
    except (PermissionError, OSError):
        return []
    result = []
    for e in entries:
        name = e.name
        if not show_hidden and name.startswith('.'):
            continue
        try:
            is_dir = e.is_dir(follow_symlinks=True)
        except OSError:
            is_dir = False
        if only_dirs and not is_dir:
            continue
        result.append((name, str(e.path), is_dir))
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].lower())
    return result

def count_descendants(path, show_hidden=False, depth=0, max_depth=5):
    """Count total descendants of a directory (recursively)."""
    if depth > max_depth:
        return 0
    try:
        entries = list_dir(path, show_hidden)
    except:
        return 0
    total = len(entries)
    for name, p, is_dir in entries:
        if is_dir:
            total += count_descendants(p, show_hidden, depth+1, max_depth)
    return total

# ── Tree building ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_print_tree(root_path, height, show_hidden=False, only_dirs=False,
                     max_depth_opt=None, pattern=None):
    """
    Build the tree output lines for :pt (print_tree) command.
    Returns list of strings (each ending in \\r\\n) including the root line.
    """
    root_path = str(Path(root_path).resolve())
    
    # Calculate effective available lines
    root_children = list_dir(root_path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
    base_state = 1 + len(root_children)  # root line + 1 per top-level item
    
    # The effective number of output lines
    if height is None:
        height = 30
    
    effective = max(height - 2, min(height - 1, base_state))
    effective = max(1, effective)
    
    lines = []
    lines.append(root_path + "\r\n")
    
    if effective <= 1:
        return lines
    
    item_budget = effective - 1  # Items budget (excluding root line)
    
    opts = dict(show_hidden=show_hidden, only_dirs=only_dirs, max_depth=max_depth_opt)
    
    sub_lines = _build_items(root_children, item_budget, [], opts, 0)
    lines.extend(sub_lines)
    
    return lines


def _build_items(children, budget, prefix_stack, opts, depth):
    """
    Recursively build tree item lines.
    children: list of (name, path, is_dir)
    budget: max lines to use
    prefix_stack: list of bools (True = has more siblings)
    Returns list of strings (each ending in \\r\\n).
    """
    if not children or budget <= 0:
        return []
    
    n = len(children)
    show_hidden = opts['show_hidden']
    only_dirs = opts['only_dirs']
    max_depth = opts['max_depth']
    
    # Check max_depth
    if max_depth is not None and depth >= max_depth:
        # Show items without expanding dirs
        result = []
        for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
            if len(result) >= budget:
                break
            is_last = (i == n-1) and len(result) == budget - 1
            # Actually just show first budget items
            if len(result) < budget:
                prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
                is_last_here = (i == min(budget, n) - 1) and (n <= budget or i == budget-1)
                branch = BRANCH_LAST if (i == n-1) else BRANCH_MID
                if is_dir:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
                else:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
        return result
    
    if n <= budget:
        # All children fit at 1 line each. Distribute extra budget among dirs.
        extra = budget - n
        
        # Allocate extra budget to expandable directories
        # Priority: sort by (desc_count ascending, position descending)
        if extra > 0:
            dir_indices = [(i, name, path) 
                          for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children) if is_dir]
            
            # Sort dirs: first by desc_count (ascending), then by position (descending)
            dir_info = []
            for i, name, path in dir_indices:
                sub = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                if sub:  # Only dirs with children can expand
                    desc = sum(1 + count_descendants(p, show_hidden, 0, 2) 
                               for _, p, _ in sub)
                    dir_info.append((desc, i, name, path, sub))
                
            dir_info.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1]))  # sort by desc count, then pos descending
            
            # Greedily allocate extra budget
            alloc = {}  # index -> budget
            remaining = extra
            for desc, i, name, path, sub in dir_info:
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                # How much does this dir need to show 1 level?
                sub_count = len(sub)
                # Give it at least 1 extra slot
                give = min(remaining, sub_count)
                if give > 0:
                    alloc[i] = give
                    remaining -= give
        else:
            alloc = {}
        
        result = []
        for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
            is_last = (i == n - 1)
            branch = BRANCH_LAST if is_last else BRANCH_MID
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            
            sub_budget = alloc.get(i, 0)
            
            if is_dir and sub_budget > 0:
                sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                if sub_children:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
                    new_stack = prefix_stack + [not is_last]
                    sub_lines = _build_items(sub_children, sub_budget, new_stack, opts, depth+1)
                    result.extend(sub_lines)
                    continue
            
            # Collapsed or leaf
            sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            if is_dir and sub_children:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
        
        return result
    
    else:
        # More children than budget. Show first (budget-1), then N unlisted.
        result = []
        
        if budget <= 0:
            return []
        
        show_count = budget - 1  # Last slot for "N unlisted"
        
        if show_count <= 0:
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{n} unlisted \r\n")
            return result
        
        for i in range(show_count):
            name, path, is_dir = children[i]
            # Not last (there's always an "unlisted" after)
            branch = BRANCH_MID
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            if is_dir and sub_children:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
        
        unlisted = n - show_count
        prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
        result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{unlisted} unlisted \r\n")
        
        return result

        elif a in ('--no-permissions','-P'):args.no_permissions = True
        elif a in ('--whale-spotting','-w'):args.whale_spotting = True
        elif a in ('--trim-root','-t'):     args.trim_root = True
        elif a in ('--no-trim-root','-T'):  args.no_trim_root = True
        elif a == '--show-root-fs':         args.show_root_fs = True
        elif a == '--git-status':           args.git_status = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-count':        args.sort_by_count = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-date':         args.sort_by_date = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-size':         args.sort_by_size = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-type':         args.sort_by_type = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-type-dirs-first': args.sort_by_type_dirs_first = True
        elif a == '--sort-by-type-dirs-last':  args.sort_by_type_dirs_last = True
        elif a == '--no-sort':              args.no_sort = True
        elif a == '--tree':                 args.tree = True
        elif a == '--no-tree':              args.no_tree = True
        elif a == '--listen-auto':          args.listen_auto = True
        elif a == '--get-root':             args.get_root = True
        elif a == '--install':              args.install = True
        elif a.startswith('--cmd=') or a == '--cmd' or a == '-c':
            args.cmd = getval('--cmd=')
        elif a.startswith('-c='):           args.cmd = a[3:]
        elif a.startswith('--color=') or a == '--color':
            args.color = getval('--color=')
        elif a.startswith('--height=') or a == '--height':
            args.height = int(getval('--height='))
        elif a.startswith('--max-depth=') or a == '--max-depth':
            args.max_depth = int(getval('--max-depth='))
        elif a.startswith('--outcmd=') or a == '--outcmd':
            args.outcmd = getval('--outcmd=')
        elif a.startswith('--conf=') or a == '--conf':
            args.conf = getval('--conf=')
        elif a.startswith('--set-install-state=') or a == '--set-install-state':
            args.set_install_state = getval('--set-install-state=')
        elif a.startswith('--print-shell-function=') or a == '--print-shell-function':
            args.print_shell_function = getval('--print-shell-function=')
        elif a.startswith('--listen=') or a == '--listen':
            args.listen = getval('--listen=')
        elif a.startswith('--write-default-conf=') or a == '--write-default-conf':
            args.write_default_conf = getval('--write-default-conf=')
        elif a.startswith('--send=') or a == '--send':
            args.send = getval('--send=')
        elif a.startswith('--verb-output=') or a == '--verb-output':
            args.verb_output = getval('--verb-output=')
        elif a == '--':
            i += 1
            if i < len(argv):
                args.root = argv[i]
            break
        elif a.startswith('-') and len(a) > 1 and not a.startswith('--'):
            # Combined short flags
            j = 1
            while j < len(a):
                c = a[j]
                if   c=='s': args.sizes=True
                elif c=='S': args.no_sizes=True
                elif c=='d': args.dates=True
                elif c=='D': args.no_dates=True
                elif c=='p': args.permissions=True
                elif c=='P': args.no_permissions=True
                elif c=='h': args.hidden=True
                elif c=='H': args.no_hidden=True
                elif c=='i': args.git_ignored=True
                elif c=='I': args.no_git_ignored=True
                elif c=='g': args.show_git_info=True
                elif c=='G': args.no_show_git_info=True
                elif c=='f': args.only_folders=True
                elif c=='F': args.no_only_folders=True
                elif c=='w': args.whale_spotting=True
                elif c=='t': args.trim_root=True
                elif c=='T': args.no_trim_root=True
                elif c=='V': args.version=True
                elif c=='c':
                    if j+1 < len(a):
                        args.cmd = a[j+1:]
                    else:
                        args.cmd = nextval()
                    break
                j += 1
        else:
            args.root = a
        
        i += 1
    
    # whale-spotting implies show hidden, show git-ignored, sort by size
    if args.whale_spotting:
        args.hidden = True
        args.git_ignored = True
        if not args.sort_by_size:
            args.sort_by_size = True
    
    return args

# ── Terminal helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def term_size():
    try:
        s = os.get_terminal_size(sys.stderr.fileno())
        return s.lines, s.columns
    except:
        try:
            s = os.get_terminal_size()
            return s.lines, s.columns
        except:
            return 24, 80

def read_key(fd, timeout=0.05):
    """Read a key sequence from fd. Returns bytes or None."""
    import select
    try:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], timeout)
        if not r:
            return None
        ch = os.read(fd, 1)
        if not ch:
            return None
        if ch == b'\x1b':
            # Try to read escape sequence
            r2, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
            if r2:
                rest = os.read(fd, 32)
                return ch + rest
        return ch
    except (OSError, IOError):
        return None

# ── TUI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class TUI:
    def __init__(self, root, args):
        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
        self.args = args
        self.rows, self.cols = term_size()
        if args.height:
            self.rows = args.height
        
        self.show_hidden = bool(args.hidden or args.whale_spotting)
        self.show_gitignored = bool(args.git_ignored)  # True = show (gitignore off)
        self.only_dirs = bool(args.only_folders)
        
        self.input_text = ""
        self.verb_mode = False
        self.sel = 0           # selected flat index (0=root)
        self.scroll = 0
        
        # Navigation history: list of (path, sel) tuples
        self.history = []
        
        # Current tree flat list: (display_str, path, is_dir, depth)
        self.flat = []
        self.needs_rebuild = True
        self.colors = (args.color != "no")
        
        # TUI file (stderr/tty)
        self.tty = None
    
    def tree_rows(self):
        """Number of rows for tree content (including root)."""
        return self.rows - 2  # status + input
    
    def run(self):
        try:
            tty_fd = os.open('/dev/tty', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY)
        except OSError:
            return None
        
        tty_file = os.fdopen(os.dup(tty_fd), 'wb', buffering=0)
        old_attrs = termios.tcgetattr(tty_fd)
        
        try:
            tty.setraw(tty_fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH)
            tty_file.write((ALT_ON + HIDE_CURSOR + MOUSE_ON).encode())
            tty_file.flush()
            self.tty = tty_file
            result = self._loop(tty_fd)
        finally:
            tty_file.write((MOUSE_OFF + SHOW_CURSOR + ALT_OFF).encode())
            tty_file.flush()
            termios.tcsetattr(tty_fd, termios.TCSAFLUSH, old_attrs)
            tty_file.close()
            os.close(tty_fd)
        
        return result
    
    def _loop(self, tty_fd):
        self._rebuild()
        self._redraw()
        
        while True:
            key = read_key(tty_fd)
            if key is None:
                continue
            action = self._handle(key)
            if action == 'quit':
                return None
            if action == 'print_tree':
                return ('print_tree', self.root)
            if action == 'cd':
                node = self._selected_node()
                if node and node[2]:  # is_dir
                    return ('cd', Path(node[1]))
                return None
            if self.needs_rebuild:
                self._rebuild()
            self._redraw()
    
    def _selected_node(self):
        if 0 < self.sel < len(self.flat):
            return self.flat[self.sel]
        return None
    
    def _handle(self, key):
        # Escape sequences
        if key == b'\x1b':
            if self.input_text or self.verb_mode:
                self.input_text = ""
                self.verb_mode = False
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            elif self.history:
                self.root, self.sel = self.history.pop()
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        if key in (b'\x1b[A', b'\x1bOA'):  # Up
            self._move(-1); return None
        if key in (b'\x1b[B', b'\x1bOB'):  # Down
            self._move(1); return None
        if key == b'\x1b[5~':  # PgUp
            self._move(-10); return None
        if key == b'\x1b[6~':  # PgDn
            self._move(10); return None
        
        if key in (b'\r', b'\n'):
            return self._enter()
        
        if key in (b'\x7f', b'\x08'):  # Backspace
            if self.input_text:
                self.input_text = self.input_text[:-1]
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        if key in (b'\x03', b'\x04'):  # Ctrl-C/D
            return 'quit'
        
        # Alt combos
        if key == b'\x1bh':  # Alt-h: toggle hidden
            self.show_hidden = not self.show_hidden
            self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        if key == b'\x1bi':  # Alt-i: toggle git-ignored
            self.show_gitignored = not self.show_gitignored
            self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        if key in (b'\x1b\r', b'\x1b\n'):  # Alt-Enter: open and quit
            return 'cd'
        
        # Regular printable char
        if len(key) == 1 and 32 <= key[0] <= 126:
            c = chr(key[0])
            if c == ' ':
                self.verb_mode = True
                self.input_text = ""
                self.needs_rebuild = False
                self._redraw()
                return None
            elif c == ':':
                self.verb_mode = True
                self.input_text = ":"
                self.needs_rebuild = False
                self._redraw()
                return None
            elif c == '?' and not self.input_text and not self.verb_mode:
                self._show_help()
                return None
            else:
                self.input_text += c
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            return None
        
        # UTF-8 multi-byte
        if len(key) > 1 and key[0] >= 0x80:
            try:
                c = key.decode('utf-8')
                self.input_text += c
                self.needs_rebuild = True
            except:
                pass
        
        return None
    
    def _enter(self):
        if self.verb_mode:
            verb = self.input_text.strip().lstrip(': ')
            self.input_text = ""
            self.verb_mode = False
            self.needs_rebuild = True
            if verb in ('q', 'quit'):
                return 'quit'
            elif verb in ('pt', 'print_tree'):
                return 'print_tree'
            return None
        
        node = self._selected_node()
        if node:
            _, path, is_dir, _ = node
            if is_dir:
                self.history.append((self.root, self.sel))
                self.root = Path(path)
                self.sel = 0
                self.input_text = ""
                self.needs_rebuild = True
                return None
        else:
            # Navigate to parent
            parent = self.root.parent
            if parent != self.root:
                self.history.append((self.root, self.sel))
                self.root = parent
                self.sel = 0
                self.needs_rebuild = True
        
        return None
    
    def _move(self, delta):
        selectable = [i for i in range(1, len(self.flat)) 
                      if self.flat[i][1] is not None]
        if not selectable:
            return
        if self.sel not in selectable:
            self.sel = selectable[0] if delta > 0 else selectable[-1]
            return
        pos = selectable.index(self.sel)
        new_pos = max(0, min(len(selectable)-1, pos + delta))
        self.sel = selectable[new_pos]
    
    def _show_help(self):
        pass  # TODO
    
    def _rebuild(self):
        """Rebuild flat display list."""
        self.needs_rebuild = False
        tr = self.tree_rows()
        
        root_children = list_dir(str(self.root), self.show_hidden, self.only_dirs)
        base_state = 1 + len(root_children)
        
        if self.args.height:
            h = self.args.height
        else:
            h = self.rows
        
        effective = max(h - 2, min(h - 1, base_state))
        effective = max(1, effective)
        
        opts = dict(show_hidden=self.show_hidden, only_dirs=self.only_dirs,
                    max_depth=self.args.max_depth)
        
        # Build flat list: (display_str, path_or_None, is_dir, depth)
        flat = [("ROOT", str(self.root), True, 0)]  # root node
        
        if effective > 1:
            items = _build_items(root_children, effective-1, [], opts, 0)
            for line in items:
                # Parse the line to get path info
                stripped = line.rstrip("\r\n")
                # Extract name from line (after last branch char)
                flat.append((stripped, None, False, 1))
        
        # Actually let me use a different approach: store nodes directly
        self.flat = self._build_flat(str(self.root), effective)
        
        if self.sel >= len(self.flat):
            self.sel = max(0, len(self.flat)-1)
    
    def _build_flat(self, root_path, available):
        """Build flat list of (display_line, abs_path, is_dir, depth)."""
        flat = []
        flat.append(("ROOT", root_path, True, 0))
        
        if available <= 1:
            return flat
        
        opts = dict(show_hidden=self.show_hidden, only_dirs=self.only_dirs,
                    max_depth=self.args.max_depth)
        root_children = list_dir(root_path, self.show_hidden, self.only_dirs)
        
        self._fill_flat(flat, root_children, available-1, [], opts, 0)
        return flat
    
    def _fill_flat(self, flat, children, budget, prefix_stack, opts, depth):
        """Fill flat list with tree items."""
        if not children or budget <= 0:
            return 0
        
        n = len(children)
        show_hidden = opts['show_hidden']
        only_dirs = opts['only_dirs']
        max_depth = opts['max_depth']
        
        used = 0
        
        if n <= budget:
            extra = budget - n
            
            # Allocate extra budget to dirs
            if extra > 0:
                dir_info = []
                for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
                    if is_dir:
                        sub = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                        if sub:
                            desc = len(sub)
                            dir_info.append((desc, i, name, path, sub))
                dir_info.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1]))
                
                alloc = {}
                remaining = extra
                for desc, i, name, path, sub in dir_info:
                    if remaining <= 0:
                        break
                    give = min(remaining, len(sub))
                    if give > 0:
                        alloc[i] = give
                        remaining -= give
            else:
                alloc = {}
            
            for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
                is_last = (i == n-1)
                branch = BRANCH_LAST if is_last else BRANCH_MID
                prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
                
                sub_budget = alloc.get(i, 0)
                sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
                
                if is_dir and sub_budget > 0 and sub_children:
                    disp = f" {prefix}{branch}{name} "
                    flat.append((disp, path, True, depth+1))
                    used += 1
                    new_stack = prefix_stack + [not is_last]
                    u = self._fill_flat(flat, sub_children, sub_budget, new_stack, opts, depth+1)
                    used += u
                elif is_dir and sub_children:
                    disp = f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} "
                    flat.append((disp, path, True, depth+1))
                    used += 1
                else:
                    disp = f" {prefix}{branch}{name} "
                    flat.append((disp, path if is_dir else path, is_dir, depth+1))
                    used += 1
        else:
            show_count = budget - 1
            if show_count <= 0:
                prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
                flat.append((f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{n} unlisted ", None, False, depth+1))
                return 1
            
            for i in range(show_count):
                name, path, is_dir = children[i]
                branch = BRANCH_MID
                prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
                sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
                if is_dir and sub_children:
                    disp = f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} "
                else:
                    disp = f" {prefix}{branch}{name} "
                flat.append((disp, path, is_dir, depth+1))
                used += 1
            
            unlisted = n - show_count
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            flat.append((f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{unlisted} unlisted ", None, False, depth+1))
            used += 1
        
        return used
    
    def _redraw(self):
        """Redraw entire TUI."""
        if self.tty is None:
            return
        
        h, w = self.rows, self.cols
        out = []
        
        tree_h = h - 2
        
        # Draw tree content
        for row in range(1, tree_h + 1):
            out.append(goto(row, 1).encode())
            
            if row == 1:
                # Root line
                root_str = str(self.root)
                if self.colors:
                    line = (BOLD + fg(110) + bg(238) + root_str + RESET + 
                            fg(254) + bg(238) + " " * max(0, w - len(root_str)) + RESET)
                else:
                    line = root_str + " " * max(0, w - len(root_str))
                out.append(line.encode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
            else:
                fi = row - 2 + self.scroll
                if 0 < fi + 1 < len(self.flat):
                    node = self.flat[fi + 1]
                    line = self._render_node(node, fi + 1 == self.sel, w)
                else:
                    if self.colors:
                        line = " " * w
                    else:
                        line = " " * w
                out.append(line.encode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        
        # Status bar (row h-1)
        out.append(goto(h-1, 1).encode())
        status = self._status()
        if self.colors:
            status_line = (bg(236) + fg(252) + " " + status + 
                          " " * max(0, w - len(status) - 1) + RESET)
        else:
            status_line = " " + status + " " * max(0, w - len(status) - 1)
        out.append(status_line.encode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        
        # Input / flags line (row h)
        out.append(goto(h, 1).encode())
        inp = self.input_text or ""
        h_val = "y" if self.show_hidden else "n"
        gi_val = "n" if self.show_gitignored else "y"
        flags_str = f" h:{h_val}  gi:{gi_val} "
        
        if self.colors:
            sel_m = "\x1b[7m\x1b[38;5;231m\x1b[48;5;234m \x1b[0m"
            inp_part = (fg(231) + bg(234) + inp + RESET + fg(254) + bg_r())
            pad = max(0, w - 1 - len(inp) - len(flags_str))
            flags_colored = (fg(247) + bg(234) + " h:" + BOLD + fg(178) + h_val + 
                            RESET + fg(247) + bg(234) + "  gi:" + BOLD + fg(178) + gi_val +
                            RESET + fg(247) + bg(234) + " " + fg(254) + bg_r() + RESET)
            input_line = sel_m + inp_part + " " * pad + flags_colored
        else:
            pad = max(0, w - len(inp) - len(flags_str))
            input_line = inp + " " * pad + flags_str
        
        out.append(input_line.encode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        
        self.tty.write(b"".join(out))
        self.tty.flush()
    
    def _render_node(self, node, selected, width):
        disp, path, is_dir, depth = node
        
        if selected:
            sel_ch = SEL_MARK
        else:
            sel_ch = " "
        
        # Replace the leading space with sel marker
        if disp.startswith(" "):
            display = sel_ch + disp[1:]
        else:
            display = sel_ch + disp
        
        display_len = len(display)
        has_scroll = len(self.flat) - 1 > self.tree_rows() - 1
        
        pad = max(0, width - display_len - (1 if has_scroll else 0))
        
        if self.colors:
            # Color the tree chars
            parts = []
            if selected:
                parts.append(fg(110) + bg(237))
            
            if is_dir and path:
                color = BOLD + fg(110)
            elif path is None:
                color = ITALIC + fg(244)
            else:
                color = fg(254)
            
            if self.colors:
                # Find branch chars
                name_start = disp.find("──") + 2 if "──" in disp else len(disp)
                pre_branch = disp[:disp.find("──")-1] if "──" in disp else disp
                
                line = (bg_r() + fg_r() +
                        (" " if not selected else fg(110) + bg(237) + SEL_MARK + RESET) +
                        fg(240) + disp[1:disp.find("──")+2].rstrip() if "──" in disp else "" +
                        RESET + color + disp[disp.find("──")+2:] if "──" in disp else disp +
                        RESET + " " * pad)
                # Simpler approach
                line = (("" if not selected else fg(110) + bg(237)) + 
                        sel_ch + RESET +
                        fg(240) + RESET +
                        color + display[1:] + RESET + 
                        " " * pad)
            else:
                line = display + " " * pad
            
            if has_scroll and selected:
                line += bg(244) + " " + RESET
            elif has_scroll:
                line += bg(244) + " " + RESET
            
            return line
        else:
            line = display + " " * pad
            if has_scroll:
                line += "▐"
            return line
    
    def _status(self):
        if self.verb_mode:
            return "Type a verb then enter to execute it (? for the list of verbs)"
        
        if self.input_text:
            return "Hit alt-Enter to open and quit, esc to clear the filter, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
        
        node = self._selected_node()
        if node:
            _, path, is_dir, _ = node
            if is_dir:
                return "Hit enter to focus, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
            return "Hit enter to open, ? for help, or a space then a verb"
        
        if self.history:
            return "Hit esc to go back, enter to go up, ? for help, or a few letters to search"
        
        return "Hit enter to go up, ? for help, or a few letters to search"

# ── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def main():
    args = parse_args(sys.argv)
    
    if args.version:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{APP_NAME} {VERSION}\n")
        return 0
    
    if args.help:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(get_help_text())
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return 0
    
    if args.print_shell_function is not None:
        data = get_shell_function(args.print_shell_function)
        if data is None:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Unknown shell: {args.print_shell_function}\n")
            return 1
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return 0
    
    if args.write_default_conf:
        write_default_conf(args.write_default_conf)
        return 0
    
    if args.set_install_state:
        set_install_state_cmd(args.set_install_state)
        return 0
    
    if args.install:
        do_install()
        return 0
    
    # Determine root
    root = Path(args.root or os.getcwd()).resolve()
    if not root.exists():
        print(f"broot: {root}: No such file or directory", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if not root.is_dir():
        root = root.parent
    
    # Ensure config exists
    ensure_config()
    
    # Check install state
    if get_install_state() == "undefined":
        do_install()
    
    # Handle --cmd
    if args.cmd:
        commands = [c.strip() for c in args.cmd.split(';')]
        for cmd in commands:
            if cmd in (':pt', ':print_tree', 'pt', 'print_tree',
                       ':pt', ':print_tree'):
                # Print tree to stdout
                show_hidden = bool(args.hidden or args.whale_spotting)
                only_dirs = bool(args.only_folders)
                h = args.height or 30

def list_dir(path, show_hidden=False, only_dirs=False):
    """Return sorted list of (name, abs_path, is_dir) for path."""
    try:
        entries = list(os.scandir(path))
    except (PermissionError, OSError):
        return []
    result = []
    for e in entries:
        name = e.name
        if not show_hidden and name.startswith('.'):
            continue
        try:
            is_dir = e.is_dir(follow_symlinks=True)
        except OSError:
            is_dir = False
        if only_dirs and not is_dir:
            continue
        result.append((name, str(e.path), is_dir))
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].lower())
    return result

def count_descendants(path, show_hidden=False, depth=0, max_depth=5):
    """Count total descendants of a directory (recursively)."""
    if depth > max_depth:
        return 0
    try:
        entries = list_dir(path, show_hidden)
    except:
        return 0
    total = len(entries)
    for name, p, is_dir in entries:
        if is_dir:
            total += count_descendants(p, show_hidden, depth+1, max_depth)
    return total

def build_print_tree(root_path, height, show_hidden=False, only_dirs=False,
                     max_depth_opt=None, pattern=None):
    """
    Build the tree output lines for :pt (print_tree) command.
    Returns list of strings (each ending in \\r\\n) including the root line.
    """
    root_path = str(Path(root_path).resolve())
    
    # Calculate effective available lines
    root_children = list_dir(root_path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
    base_state = 1 + len(root_children)  # root line + 1 per top-level item
    
    # The effective number of output lines
    if height is None:
        height = 30
    
    effective = max(height - 2, min(height - 1, base_state))
    effective = max(1, effective)
    
    lines = []
    lines.append(root_path + "\r\n")
    
    if effective <= 1:
        return lines
    
    item_budget = effective - 1  # Items budget (excluding root line)
    
    opts = dict(show_hidden=show_hidden, only_dirs=only_dirs, max_depth=max_depth_opt)
    
    sub_lines = _build_items(root_children, item_budget, [], opts, 0)
    lines.extend(sub_lines)
    
    return lines


def _build_items(children, budget, prefix_stack, opts, depth):
    """
    Recursively build tree item lines.
    children: list of (name, path, is_dir)
    budget: max lines to use
    prefix_stack: list of bools (True = has more siblings)
    Returns list of strings (each ending in \\r\\n).
    """
    if not children or budget <= 0:
        return []
    
    n = len(children)
    show_hidden = opts['show_hidden']
    only_dirs = opts['only_dirs']
    max_depth = opts['max_depth']
    
    # Check max_depth
    if max_depth is not None and depth >= max_depth:
        # Show items without expanding dirs
        result = []
        for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
            if len(result) >= budget:
                break
            is_last = (i == n-1) and len(result) == budget - 1
            # Actually just show first budget items
            if len(result) < budget:
                prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
                is_last_here = (i == min(budget, n) - 1) and (n <= budget or i == budget-1)
                branch = BRANCH_LAST if (i == n-1) else BRANCH_MID
                if is_dir:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
                else:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
        return result
    
    if n <= budget:
        # All children fit at 1 line each. Distribute extra budget among dirs.
        extra = budget - n
        
        # Allocate extra budget to expandable directories
        # Priority: sort by (desc_count ascending, position descending)
        if extra > 0:
            dir_indices = [(i, name, path) 
                          for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children) if is_dir]
            
            # Sort dirs: first by desc_count (ascending), then by position (descending)
            dir_info = []
            for i, name, path in dir_indices:
                sub = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                if sub:  # Only dirs with children can expand
                    desc = sum(1 + count_descendants(p, show_hidden, 0, 2) 
                               for _, p, _ in sub)
                    dir_info.append((desc, i, name, path, sub))
                
            dir_info.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1]))  # sort by desc count, then pos descending
            
            # Greedily allocate extra budget
            alloc = {}  # index -> budget
            remaining = extra
            for desc, i, name, path, sub in dir_info:
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                # How much does this dir need to show 1 level?
                sub_count = len(sub)
                # Give it at least 1 extra slot
                give = min(remaining, sub_count)
                if give > 0:
                    alloc[i] = give
                    remaining -= give
        else:
            alloc = {}
        
        result = []
        for i, (name, path, is_dir) in enumerate(children):
            is_last = (i == n - 1)
            branch = BRANCH_LAST if is_last else BRANCH_MID
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            
            sub_budget = alloc.get(i, 0)
            
            if is_dir and sub_budget > 0:
                sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs)
                if sub_children:
                    result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
                    new_stack = prefix_stack + [not is_last]
                    sub_lines = _build_items(sub_children, sub_budget, new_stack, opts, depth+1)
                    result.extend(sub_lines)
                    continue
            
            # Collapsed or leaf
            sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            if is_dir and sub_children:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")

    else:
        # More children than budget. Show first (budget-1), then N unlisted.
        result = []
        
        if budget <= 0:
            return []
        
        show_count = budget - 1  # Last slot for "N unlisted"
        
        if show_count <= 0:
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{n} unlisted \r\n")
            return result
        
        for i in range(show_count):
            name, path, is_dir = children[i]
            # Not last (there's always an "unlisted" after)
            branch = BRANCH_MID
            prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
            sub_children = list_dir(path, show_hidden, only_dirs) if is_dir else []
            if is_dir and sub_children:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} {ELLIPSIS} \r\n")
            else:
                result.append(f" {prefix}{branch}{name} \r\n")
        
        unlisted = n - show_count
        prefix = "".join(VERT_CONT if h else INDENT for h in prefix_stack)
        result.append(f" {prefix}{BRANCH_LAST}{unlisted} unlisted \r\n")
